results.question: How many annual leave days do employees receive?
results.actual_response: Standard full-time corporate employees receive exactly 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

results.question: How many unused annual leave days can be carried forward?
results.actual_response: Employees can carry forward up to five unused annual leave days into the next calendar year.

results.question: How long is the probation period?
results.actual_response: The probation period is three months.
